title: Mathias Kaminsky
summary: Caleb Dunne's Division partner in Extremis Malis, killed by Mantis during the opening Chinatown warehouse encounter.

claims.text: Extremis Malis presents Mathias Kaminsky as Caleb Dunne's Division partner in the Chinatown warehouse operation.
Mantis kills Kaminsky after the warehouse confrontation, which makes the pursuit of Mantis the graphic novel's immediate personal stake for Caleb.

paragraphs.text: Kaminsky's death is the event that turns the New York lead into Caleb's personal pursuit of Mantis. The archive records it as a major spoiler because the official edition uses it to launch the full prequel route.

verification.notes: Outcome is a major plot spoiler in the licensed graphic novel.
